cohort: 2581 babies born at Dhulikhel Hospital between December 15, 2015, and December 15, 2016
finding: While meconium stained amniotic fluid was common, progression to meconium aspiration syndrome was not associated with maternal or neonatal factors studied, but thick meconium was associated with increased operative deliveries and neonatal complications.
mod_finding: Babies delivered by cesarean section were more frequent in the meconium stained amniotic fluid group than the Meconium aspiration syndrome group (47.5% VS 33.3%).
